### Ephesus and the Loss of First Love
Author: Michael Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-march-13-2023.html
Passage: Revelation 2:4
Points:
- The Ephesian church was faithful, persevering through hardship and resisting false teachings.
- Despite their commendable actions and sound doctrine, they abandoned their initial love.
- Believers risk being busy with religious activity while neglecting personal intimacy with Christ.
- Jesus desires heartfelt devotion from His people far more than exterior accomplishments.
- Followers of Christ must pause, reorder priorities, and return to an intimate relationship with Him.

### What Makes God Sick?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-september-8-2019.html
Passage: Revelation 2:4
Points:
- The church at Ephesus had not rejected Jesus, but their love for Him had cooled over time.
- Loving Jesus less than before is a sure indication of spiritual decline and backsliding.
- Lukewarm faith treats God's great love and sacrifice with apathy and indifference.
- Believers frequently allow self-will to usurp Christ's rightful place on the throne of their hearts.
- Christ calls drifting believers to repent, open the door to Him, and rekindle their spiritual fire.
